question: On 15 August 2026, Elon Musk announced that, on his X platform, any government-imposed censorship would now be ‘clearly visible’1. As a result, changes to the algorithm resulting from government requests will be made public. This public information is likely to increase the accountability of states that do not respect freedom of expression and would enable people to better understand X’s recommendations. The practice could also promote more transparent and fair electoral processes. 1.
Is the Commission aware of this step that X has taken?
If so, does it intend to encourage all competing platforms to also publish government censorship requests?
